items.title: Verizon CEO shuts down Starlink MVNO talk, touts strong Q2 comeback
items.summary: Verizon CEO Dan Schulman took a victory lap of sorts today, declaring Verizon’s best second quarter in five years, with 184,000 postpaid phone net additions and more than 550,000 total mobility and broadband net additions in Q2.

items.title: Amazon Leo aims for 5,105 satellites in D2D constellation
items.summary: Amazon Leo wants to deploy up to 5,105 new satellites using Globalstar’s spectrum as part of its upcoming direct-to-device (D2D) satellite cell phone service.

items.title: AT&T closes $23B spectrum deal with EchoStar
items.summary: AT&T closed its transaction with EchoStar to acquire about 30 MHz of nationwide 3.45 GHz spectrum and about 20 MHz of nationwide 600 MHz of low-band spectrum for about $23 billion.

items.title: Bain, Tillman, Eaton, Ripple join in $1.5B collaboration to expand Verizon fiber broadband
items.summary: The plan is to expand Verizon’s fiber broadband network to 1 million more locations outside its wired footprint.

items.title: T-Mobile service restored after major outage
items.summary: T-Mobile said it fully restored service after a network outage affected customers across the country on Monday. The carrier didn’t disclose what caused the outage.

items.title: Analysts give Charter some ideas for satellite integrations during Q2 2026 earnings
items.summary: During its second quarter 2026, Charter lost 172,000 broadband subscribers, but it added 406,000 Spectrum Mobile lines.

items.title: Opinion: Kinetic tokens could be $250B market opp for telcos
items.summary: In physical AI, telcos have an opportunity to capture the AI inference market, according to Mobile Experts' latest research.

items.title: Shentel revenue rises, loss shrinks in Q2
items.summary: The operator surpassed 100,000 Glo Fiber customers in the quarter, with fiber now accounting for 51% of its overall revenue.

items.title: AT&T at ‘the backend’ of converting Lumen fiber customers to AT&T Fiber
items.summary: Although AT&T is working hard to integrate these new customers, there doesn’t appear to be any consistent branding, yet.

items.title: AT&T joins growing list of telcos making quantum moves in 2026

items.title: Why configuration and change management matter in autonomous networks
items.summary: As carriers pursue autonomous networking, configuration and change management are essential for maintaining a trusted network state and confidence in automation.
